title: UC San Diego Surface Lot Parking Dashboard
description: Built for UC San Diego Transportation Services and highlighted to campus leadership, including the Vice Chancellor. With my team, mapped every surface-lot parking space on campus, then used ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Dashboards to design an interactive dashboard that breaks down all 12,718 spaces by area, lot, permit type, and time limit.

title: Gram for Gram: The Sugar in 'Better-for-You' Foods
description: Won the DSC 106 Project 1 award for creativity out of 200+ students. A persuasive visualization built from cleaned GroceryDB data revealing that 'healthy' fruit and granola bars pack more sugar per 100 g than cookies, cakes, and ice cream, with each grocery aisle drawn as a dripping drop of icing.

title: Bikewatching: Boston Bike Traffic Map
description: Interactive Mapbox + D3 map of about 260,000 Bluebikes trips, with stations sized by traffic, colors showing arrivals vs. departures, and a time-of-day filter kept fast by pre-sorting trips into per-minute buckets.

title: This Website: A Portfolio That Visualizes Itself
description: Designed and coded from scratch in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: a data-driven projects page with a D3 pie chart filter and search, live GitHub stats, a light/dark theme, and a scrollytelling page that animates the history of this site's own code.

title: When the Lights Go Out: U.S. Power Outage Analysis
description: Analyzed 1,534 major U.S. power outages (2000–2016) to predict how many customers an outage affects. Ran permutation tests on missing data and seasonality, built a Random Forest model that beat a linear baseline, and tested it for fairness across regions.

title: Demographic Factors in Migrant Child Detention
description: Five-person research project. Designed the data plan and statistical models (A/B testing, classification) and wrote the discussion on bias and fairness.
